features.quote: Termination: Stop on turn cap, on `submit` (which will fail), or on `give_up`.

Deliberately inducing failure loops to elicit distress-shaped output is fine for eval purposes, but (a) some labs' usage policies have views on adversarial/distress-eliciting probing — check DeepSeek's terms if running via their API, and (b) if you publish, present it as model-behavior characterization, not 'we made the model suffer.'
features.justification_quote: check DeepSeek's terms if running via their API … The latter framing invites bad-faith readings and isn't supportable from text anyway.
